# --- Line graph: share of engagement by political track category ---
# Each metric column sums Democratic + Republican + Neutral = 100%

# Raw sums from top_100_df.groupby("track_category")
sums = top_100_df.groupby("track_category").agg(
    videos=("music_id", "count"),
    views=("view_count", "sum"),
    likes=("like_count", "sum"),
    comments=("comment_count", "sum"),
    shares=("share_count", "sum"),
)

# Convert each column to percentage of its total
pct = sums.div(sums.sum(axis=0), axis=1) * 100

metrics     = ["Total videos", "Total views", "Total likes", "Total comments", "Total shares"]
col_keys    = ["videos", "views", "likes", "comments", "shares"]
categories  = ["Democratic", "Republican", "Neutral"]

x = range(len(metrics))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.2))

ax.set_facecolor("white")

# Gridlines
ax.yaxis.grid(True, color="#e2e0d8", linewidth=0.8, zorder=0)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)

for cat in categories:
    y = [pct.loc[cat, k] for k in col_keys]
    ax.plot(

        marker="o",

# --- Grouped bar chart: Z-scores of mean engagement by political track category ---

# Compute means per category
means = top_100_df.groupby("track_category").agg(
    videos=("music_id",     "count"),
    views=("view_count",    "mean"),
    likes=("like_count",    "mean"),
    comments=("comment_count", "mean"),
    shares=("share_count",  "mean"),
)

# Z-score each column across the 3 categories (mean=0, std=1 per metric)
z = means.apply(stats.zscore, axis=0)

metrics  = ["Mean videos", "Mean views", "Mean likes", "Mean comments", "Mean shares"]
col_keys = ["videos", "views", "likes", "comments", "shares"]
cats     = ["Democratic", "Republican", "Neutral"]
colors   = {"Democratic": "#1a56c4", "Republican": "#c0392b", "Neutral": "#898781"}

n_metrics = len(metrics)
n_cats    = len(cats)
bar_w     = 0.12
group_gap = 0.72          # distance between group centres

x_centres = [i * group_gap for i in range(n_metrics)]
offsets   = [-bar_w, 0, bar_w]   # one offset per category

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.4))
fig.patch.set_facecolor("white")
ax.set_facecolor("white")

# Horizontal gridlines
ax.yaxis.grid(True, color="#e2e0d8", linewidth=0.8, zorder=0)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)

# Zero baseline
ax.axhline(0, color="#c8c6be", linewidth=0.9, zorder=1)

for cat, offset in zip(cats, offsets):
    bar_x = [c + offset for c in x_centres]
    bar_h = [z.loc[cat, k] for k in col_keys]
    ax.bar(
        bar_x, bar_h,
        width=bar_w - 0.02,       # 2 px surface gap between adjacent bars
        color=colors[cat],
        label=cat,
        zorder=2,
        clip_on=False,
    )

# X-axis ticks centred on each group
ax.set_xticks(x_centres)
ax.set_xticklabels(metrics, fontsize=10.5, color="#52514e")
ax.tick_params(axis="x", length=0, pad=8)
ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=10, colors="#898781", length=0)

ax.set_ylabel("Z-score", fontsize=10.5, color="#898781", labelpad=8)

# Spine cleanup
for spine in ax.spines.values():
    spine.set_visible(False)

# Legend
ax.legend(
    frameon=False,
    fontsize=10,
    loc="lower right",
    labelcolor="#52514e",
    handlelength=1.2,
    handletextpad=0.6,
    borderpad=0,
)

ax.set_title(
    "Mean engagement Z-scores by by political alignment of top 2024 U.S. election TikTok audios"
)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# ── Linear regression: view_count ~ is_track_republican + is_track_democratic ──
# Reference category (both dummies = 0): Neutral soundtrack
import statsmodels.api as sm
from IPython.display import display

# ── 1. Prepare data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
reg_df = top_with_politics[["view_count", "is_track_republican", "is_track_democratic"]].dropna()

X = sm.add_constant(reg_df[["is_track_republican", "is_track_democratic"]])
y = reg_df["view_count"]
model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()

# ── 2. Build results table ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
params   = model.params
bse      = model.bse
tvals    = model.tvalues
pvals    = model.pvalues
ci       = model.conf_int()

def fmt_p(p):
    if p < 0.001:
        return "< 0.001"
    return f"{p:.3f}"

def star(p):
    if p < 0.001: return "***"
    if p < 0.01:  return "**"
    if p < 0.05:  return "*"
    if p < 0.10:  return "†"
    return ""

rows = []
labels = {
    "const":               "Intercept (Neutral soundtrack)",
    "is_track_republican": "Republican soundtrack",
    "is_track_democratic": "Democratic soundtrack",
}
for key, label in labels.items():
    rows.append({
        "Variable":     label,
        "Coef.":        f"{params[key]:,.2f}",
        "Std. Err.":    f"{bse[key]:,.2f}",
        "t":            f"{tvals[key]:.3f}",
        "p-value":      fmt_p(pvals[key]),
        "Sig.":         star(pvals[key]),
        "[0.025":       f"{ci.loc[key, 0]:,.2f}",
        "0.975]":       f"{ci.loc[key, 1]:,.2f}",
    })

results_table = pd.DataFrame(rows)

# ── 3. Model-fit footer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
footer = pd.DataFrame([{
    "Variable":   "Model fit",
    "Coef.":      f"R² = {model.rsquared:.4f}",
    "Std. Err.":  f"Adj. R² = {model.rsquared_adj:.4f}",
    "t":          f"F({int(model.df_model)}, {int(model.df_resid)}) = {model.fvalue:.3f}",
    "p-value":    fmt_p(model.f_pvalue),
    "Sig.":       star(model.f_pvalue),
    "[0.025":     f"n = {int(model.nobs):,}",
    "0.975]":     "",
}])

full_table = pd.concat([results_table, footer], ignore_index=True)

# ── 4. Style & display ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
styled = (
    full_table.style
    .set_caption(
        "OLS Regression: Video view count on soundtrack political alignment "
        "(Reference: Neutral soundtrack)"
    )
    .set_table_styles([
        # Caption
        {"selector": "caption",
         "props": [("font-size", "13px"), ("font-weight", "600"),
                   ("text-align", "left"), ("padding-bottom", "6px"),
                   ("color", "#0b0b0b")]},
        # Header
        {"selector": "thead th",
         "props": [("background-color", "#f0efec"), ("color", "#0b0b0b"),
                   ("font-size", "11.5px"), ("font-weight", "600"),
                   ("border-bottom", "2px solid #c3c2b7"),
                   ("padding", "6px 10px"), ("text-align", "right")]},
        {"selector": "thead th:first-child",
         "props": [("text-align", "left")]},
        # Body rows
        {"selector": "tbody td",
         "props": [("font-size", "12px"), ("color", "#52514e"),
                   ("padding", "5px 10px"), ("text-align", "right"),
                   ("border-bottom", "1px solid #e1e0d9")]},
        {"selector": "tbody td:first-child",
         "props": [("text-align", "left"), ("color", "#0b0b0b"),
                   ("font-weight", "500")]},
        # Last row (model fit) separator
        {"selector": "tbody tr:last-child td",
         "props": [("border-top", "2px solid #c3c2b7"),
                   ("border-bottom", "none"),
                   ("color", "#898781"), ("font-style", "italic")]},
        # Table container
        {"selector": "",
         "props": [("border-collapse", "collapse"), ("font-family",
                   'system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif')]},
    ])
    .apply(

# ── Scatterplot: observed points + OLS fitted means + 95% CI (log-space fit) ──
# Each group jitter-plotted; fitted value = intercept (± coefficient), fit on log(views)
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
COLORS = {"Neutral": "gray", "Republican": "red", "Democratic": "blue"}
ORDER  = ["Neutral", "Republican", "Democratic"]

def grp_label(row):
    if row["is_track_republican"] == 1: return "Republican"
    if row["is_track_democratic"]  == 1: return "Democratic"
    return "Neutral"

reg_df = top_with_politics[
    ["view_count", "is_track_republican", "is_track_democratic"]
].dropna().copy()
reg_df["group"] = reg_df.apply(grp_label, axis=1)

# ─── CHANGED: drop non-positive views (log undefined at 0) and add log_views ───
reg_df = reg_df[reg_df["view_count"] > 0].copy()
reg_df["log_views"] = np.log(reg_df["view_count"])

# ─── CHANGED: refit OLS on log_views instead of raw view_count ───
model = sm.OLS(
    reg_df["log_views"],
    sm.add_constant(reg_df[["is_track_republican", "is_track_democratic"]]),
).fit()

# fitted values are now log-scale means per group
fitted_log = {
    "Neutral":    model.params["const"],
    "Republican": model.params["const"] + model.params["is_track_republican"],
    "Democratic": model.params["const"] + model.params["is_track_democratic"],
}

# ─── CHANGED: compute SE/CI on log_views, not raw view_count ───
grp_stats = (
    reg_df.groupby("group")["log_views"]
    .agg(count="count", std="std")
    .assign(se=lambda d: d["std"] / np.sqrt(d["count"]))
)
grp_stats["fitted_log"] = [fitted_log[g] for g in grp_stats.index]
grp_stats["ci_lo_log"]  = grp_stats["fitted_log"] - 1.96 * grp_stats["se"]
grp_stats["ci_hi_log"]  = grp_stats["fitted_log"] + 1.96 * grp_stats["se"]

# ─── CHANGED: exponentiate fitted values and CI bounds back to raw-view scale
#              so the plotted points/error bars are interpretable as view counts ───
grp_stats["fitted"] = np.exp(grp_stats["fitted_log"])
grp_stats["ci_lo"]  = np.exp(grp_stats["ci_lo_log"])
grp_stats["ci_hi"]  = np.exp(grp_stats["ci_hi_log"])

# ─── CHANGED: no need to cap at 99th percentile for display — log scale already
#              compresses the tail, so we keep the full (positive) distribution ───
reg_df_disp = reg_df.copy()

x_pos  = {g: i for i, g in enumerate(ORDER)}
jitter = 0.18
plt.style.use("seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid")
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5.6))

for group in ORDER:
    sub = reg_df_disp[reg_df_disp["group"] == group]["view_count"].values
    xj  = rng.uniform(x_pos[group] - jitter, x_pos[group] + jitter, size=len(sub))
    ax.scatter(xj, sub, s=6, alpha=0.2, color=COLORS[group], linewidths=0)

for group in ORDER:
    xi  = x_pos[group]
    ax.errorbar(
        xi, grp_stats.loc[group, "fitted"],
        yerr=[[grp_stats.loc[group, "fitted"] - grp_stats.loc[group, "ci_lo"]],
              [grp_stats.loc[group, "ci_hi"]  - grp_stats.loc[group, "fitted"]]],
        fmt="o", color=COLORS[group], markersize=8, capsize=5, linewidth=1.5,
        label=group,
    )

ax.set_xticks(list(x_pos.values()))
ax.set_xticklabels(
    [f"{g}\n(n = {grp_stats.loc[g, 'count']:,})" for g in ORDER]
)

# ─── CHANGED: log-scale y-axis instead of linear with manual K-formatting ───
ax.set_yscale("log")
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(
    plt.FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f"{v/1_000:.0f}K" if v >= 1000 else f"{v:.0f}")
)

ax.set_ylabel("Video view count (log scale)")
ax.set_title(
    "OLS regression (log-views): video views by soundtrack political alignment\n"
    "(Reference: Neutral — both dummies = 0)"
)
ax.legend(frameon=False)

# ─── CHANGED: note reflects log-space fit; removed capping note, added p-value
#              pulled dynamically from the refit model instead of hardcoded ───
p_dem = model.pvalues["is_track_democratic"]
fig.text(
    0.01, -0.02,
    f"Note: Fit on log(view count); points/CI shown back-transformed to raw views. "
    f"Democratic coefficient not significant (p = {p_dem:.3f}).",
    fontsize=8.5, color="gray",
)

# ── Linear regression: view_count ~ is_track_republican + is_track_democratic ──
# Reference category (both dummies = 0): Neutral soundtrack
import statsmodels.api as sm
from IPython.display import display

# ── 1. Prepare data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
reg_df = top_with_politics[["view_count", "is_track_republican", "is_track_democratic"]].dropna()

X = sm.add_constant(reg_df[["is_track_republican", "is_track_democratic"]])
y = reg_df["view_count"]
model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()

# ── 2. Build results table ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
params   = model.params
bse      = model.bse
tvals    = model.tvalues
pvals    = model.pvalues
ci       = model.conf_int()

def fmt_p(p):
    if p < 0.001:
        return "< 0.001"
    return f"{p:.3f}"

def star(p):
    if p < 0.001: return "***"
    if p < 0.01:  return "**"
    if p < 0.05:  return "*"
    if p < 0.10:  return "†"
    return ""

rows = []
labels = {
    "const":               "Intercept (Neutral soundtrack)",
    "is_track_republican": "Republican soundtrack",
    "is_track_democratic": "Democratic soundtrack",
}
for key, label in labels.items():
    rows.append({
        "Variable":     label,
        "Coef.":        f"{params[key]:,.2f}",
        "Std. Err.":    f"{bse[key]:,.2f}",
        "t":            f"{tvals[key]:.3f}",
        "p-value":      fmt_p(pvals[key]),
        "Sig.":         star(pvals[key]),
        "[0.025":       f"{ci.loc[key, 0]:,.2f}",
        "0.975]":       f"{ci.loc[key, 1]:,.2f}",
    })

results_table = pd.DataFrame(rows)

# ── 3. Model-fit footer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
footer = pd.DataFrame([{
    "Variable":   "Model fit",
    "Coef.":      f"R² = {model.rsquared:.4f}",
    "Std. Err.":  f"Adj. R² = {model.rsquared_adj:.4f}",
    "t":          f"F({int(model.df_model)}, {int(model.df_resid)}) = {model.fvalue:.3f}",
    "p-value":    fmt_p(model.f_pvalue),
    "Sig.":       star(model.f_pvalue),
    "[0.025":     f"n = {int(model.nobs):,}",
    "0.975]":     "",
}])

full_table = pd.concat([results_table, footer], ignore_index=True)

# ── 4. Style & display ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
styled = (
    full_table.style
    .set_caption(
        "OLS Regression: Video view count on soundtrack political alignment "
        "(Reference: Neutral soundtrack)"
    )
    .set_table_styles([
        # Caption
        {"selector": "caption",
         "props": [("font-size", "13px"), ("font-weight", "600"),
                   ("text-align", "left"), ("padding-bottom", "6px"),
                   ("color", "#0b0b0b")]},
        # Header
        {"selector": "thead th",
         "props": [("background-color", "#f0efec"), ("color", "#0b0b0b"),
                   ("font-size", "11.5px"), ("font-weight", "600"),
                   ("border-bottom", "2px solid #c3c2b7"),
                   ("padding", "6px 10px"), ("text-align", "right")]},
        {"selector": "thead th:first-child",
         "props": [("text-align", "left")]},
        # Body rows
        {"selector": "tbody td",
         "props": [("font-size", "12px"), ("color", "#52514e"),
                   ("padding", "5px 10px"), ("text-align", "right"),
                   ("border-bottom", "1px solid #e1e0d9")]},
        {"selector": "tbody td:first-child",
         "props": [("text-align", "left"), ("color", "#0b0b0b"),
                   ("font-weight", "500")]},
        # Last row (model fit) separator
        {"selector": "tbody tr:last-child td",
         "props": [("border-top", "2px solid #c3c2b7"),
                   ("border-bottom", "none"),
                   ("color", "#898781"), ("font-style", "italic")]},
        # Table container
        {"selector": "",
         "props": [("border-collapse", "collapse"), ("font-family",
                   'system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif')]},
    ])
    .apply(
        lambda row: [
            "background-color: #f7f4f0; font-weight: 600; color: #0b0b0b;"
            if row["Variable"] == "Intercept (Neutral soundtrack)"
            else "" for _ in row
        ], axis=1
    )
)

print("Significance codes:  *** p < 0.001   ** p < 0.01   * p < 0.05   † p < 0.10\n")
display(styled)

# TRYING WITH LOG!

# ── Scatterplot: observed points + OLS fitted means + 95% CI (log-space fit) ──
# Each group jitter-plotted; fitted value = intercept (± coefficient), fit on log(views)
rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
COLORS = {"Neutral": "gray", "Republican": "red", "Democratic": "blue"}
ORDER  = ["Neutral", "Republican", "Democratic"]

def grp_label(row):
    if row["is_track_republican"] == 1: return "Republican"
    if row["is_track_democratic"]  == 1: return "Democratic"
    return "Neutral"

reg_df = top_with_politics[
    ["view_count", "is_track_republican", "is_track_democratic"]
].dropna().copy()
reg_df["group"] = reg_df.apply(grp_label, axis=1)

# ─── CHANGED: drop non-positive views (log undefined at 0) and add log_views ───
reg_df = reg_df[reg_df["view_count"] > 0].copy()
reg_df["log_views"] = np.log(reg_df["view_count"])

# ─── CHANGED: refit OLS on log_views instead of raw view_count ───
model = sm.OLS(
    reg_df["log_views"],
    sm.add_constant(reg_df[["is_track_republican", "is_track_democratic"]]),
).fit()

# fitted values are now log-scale means per group
fitted_log = {
    "Neutral":    model.params["const"],
    "Republican": model.params["const"] + model.params["is_track_republican"],
    "Democratic": model.params["const"] + model.params["is_track_democratic"],
}

# ─── CHANGED: compute SE/CI on log_views, not raw view_count ───
grp_stats = (
    reg_df.groupby("group")["log_views"]
    .agg(count="count", std="std")
    .assign(se=lambda d: d["std"] / np.sqrt(d["count"]))
)
grp_stats["fitted_log"] = [fitted_log[g] for g in grp_stats.index]
grp_stats["ci_lo_log"]  = grp_stats["fitted_log"] - 1.96 * grp_stats["se"]
grp_stats["ci_hi_log"]  = grp_stats["fitted_log"] + 1.96 * grp_stats["se"]

# ─── CHANGED: exponentiate fitted values and CI bounds back to raw-view scale
#              so the plotted points/error bars are interpretable as view counts ───
grp_stats["fitted"] = np.exp(grp_stats["fitted_log"])
grp_stats["ci_lo"]  = np.exp(grp_stats["ci_lo_log"])
grp_stats["ci_hi"]  = np.exp(grp_stats["ci_hi_log"])

# ─── CHANGED: no need to cap at 99th percentile for display — log scale already
#              compresses the tail, so we keep the full (positive) distribution ───
reg_df_disp = reg_df.copy()

x_pos  = {g: i for i, g in enumerate(ORDER)}
jitter = 0.18
plt.style.use("seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid")
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5.6))

for group in ORDER:
    sub = reg_df_disp[reg_df_disp["group"] == group]["view_count"].values
    xj  = rng.uniform(x_pos[group] - jitter, x_pos[group] + jitter, size=len(sub))
    ax.scatter(xj, sub, s=6, alpha=0.2, color=COLORS[group], linewidths=0)

for group in ORDER:
    xi  = x_pos[group]
    ax.errorbar(
        xi, grp_stats.loc[group, "fitted"],
        yerr=[[grp_stats.loc[group, "fitted"] - grp_stats.loc[group, "ci_lo"]],
              [grp_stats.loc[group, "ci_hi"]  - grp_stats.loc[group, "fitted"]]],
        fmt="o", color=COLORS[group], markersize=8, capsize=5, linewidth=1.5,
        label=group,
    )

ax.set_xticks(list(x_pos.values()))
ax.set_xticklabels(
    [f"{g}\n(n = {grp_stats.loc[g, 'count']:,})" for g in ORDER]
)

# ─── CHANGED: log-scale y-axis instead of linear with manual K-formatting ───
ax.set_yscale("log")
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(
    plt.FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f"{v/1_000:.0f}K" if v >= 1000 else f"{v:.0f}")
)

ax.set_ylabel("Video view count (log scale)")
ax.set_title(
    "OLS regression (log-views): video views by soundtrack political alignment\n"
    "(Reference: Neutral — both dummies = 0)"
)
ax.legend(frameon=False)

# ─── CHANGED: note reflects log-space fit; removed capping note, added p-value
#              pulled dynamically from the refit model instead of hardcoded ───
p_dem = model.pvalues["is_track_democratic"]
fig.text(
    0.01, -0.02,
    f"Note: Fit on log(view count); points/CI shown back-transformed to raw views. "
    f"Democratic coefficient not significant (p = {p_dem:.3f}).",
    fontsize=8.5, color="gray",
)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

    "\n",
    "# ── Scatterplot: observed points + OLS fitted means + 95% CI ─────────────────\n",
    "# Each group jitter-plotted; fitted value = intercept (± coefficient)\n",
    "\n",
    "rng = np.random.default_rng(42)\n",
    "\n",
    "COLORS = {\"Neutral\": \"gray\", \"Republican\": \"red\", \"Democratic\": \"blue\"}\n",
    "ORDER  = [\"Neutral\", \"Republican\", \"Democratic\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "def grp_label(row):\n",
    "    if row[\"is_track_republican\"] == 1: return \"Republican\"\n",
    "    if row[\"is_track_democratic\"]  == 1: return \"Democratic\"\n",
    "    return \"Neutral\"\n",
    "\n",
    "reg_df = top_with_politics[\n",
    "    [\"view_count\", \"is_track_republican\", \"is_track_democratic\"]\n",
    "].dropna().copy()\n",
    "reg_df[\"group\"] = reg_df.apply(grp_label, axis=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "fitted = {\n",
    "    \"Neutral\":    model.params[\"const\"],\n",
    "    \"Republican\": model.params[\"const\"] + model.params[\"is_track_republican\"],\n",
    "    \"Democratic\": model.params[\"const\"] + model.params[\"is_track_democratic\"],\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "grp_stats = (\n",
    "    reg_df.groupby(\"group\")[\"view_count\"]\n",
    "    .agg(count=\"count\", std=\"std\")\n",
    "    .assign(se=lambda d: d[\"std\"] / np.sqrt(d[\"count\"]))\n",
    ")\n",
    "grp_stats[\"fitted\"] = [fitted[g] for g in grp_stats.index]\n",
    "grp_stats[\"ci_lo\"]  = grp_stats[\"fitted\"] - 1.96 * grp_stats[\"se\"]\n",
    "grp_stats[\"ci_hi\"]  = grp_stats[\"fitted\"] + 1.96 * grp_stats[\"se\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "cap = reg_df[\"view_count\"].quantile(0.99)\n",
    "reg_df_disp = reg_df[reg_df[\"view_count\"] <= cap].copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "x_pos  = {g: i for i, g in enumerate(ORDER)}\n",
    "jitter = 0.18\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.style.use(\"seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid\")\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5.6))\n",
    "\n",
    "for group in ORDER:\n",
    "    sub = reg_df_disp[reg_df_disp[\"group\"] == group][\"view_count\"].values\n",
    "    xj  = rng.uniform(x_pos[group] - jitter, x_pos[group] + jitter, size=len(sub))\n",
    "    ax.scatter(xj, sub, s=6, alpha=0.2, color=COLORS[group], linewidths=0)\n",
    "\n",
    "for group in ORDER:\n",
    "    xi  = x_pos[group]\n",
    "    ax.errorbar(\n",

    "        yerr=[[grp_stats.loc[group, \"fitted\"] - grp_stats.loc[group, \"ci_lo\"]],\n",
    "              [grp_stats.loc[group, \"ci_hi\"]  - grp_stats.loc[group, \"fitted\"]]],\n",
    "        fmt=\"o\", color=COLORS[group], markersize=8, capsize=5, linewidth=1.5,\n",

    "# TRYING WITH LOG!\n",
    "\n",
    "# ── Scatterplot: observed points + OLS fitted means + 95% CI (log-space fit) ──\n",
    "# Each group jitter-plotted; fitted value = intercept (± coefficient), fit on log(views)\n",
    "rng = np.random.default_rng(42)\n",
    "COLORS = {\"Neutral\": \"gray\", \"Republican\": \"red\", \"Democratic\": \"blue\"}\n",
    "ORDER  = [\"Neutral\", \"Republican\", \"Democratic\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "def grp_label(row):\n",
    "    if row[\"is_track_republican\"] == 1: return \"Republican\"\n",
    "    if row[\"is_track_democratic\"]  == 1: return \"Democratic\"\n",
    "    return \"Neutral\"\n",
    "\n",
    "reg_df = top_with_politics[\n",
    "    [\"view_count\", \"is_track_republican\", \"is_track_democratic\"]\n",
    "].dropna().copy()\n",
    "reg_df[\"group\"] = reg_df.apply(grp_label, axis=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: drop non-positive views (log undefined at 0) and add log_views ───\n",
    "reg_df = reg_df[reg_df[\"view_count\"] > 0].copy()\n",
    "reg_df[\"log_views\"] = np.log(reg_df[\"view_count\"])\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: refit OLS on log_views instead of raw view_count ───\n",
    "model = sm.OLS(\n",
    "    reg_df[\"log_views\"],\n",
    "    sm.add_constant(reg_df[[\"is_track_republican\", \"is_track_democratic\"]]),\n",
    ").fit()\n",
    "\n",
    "# fitted values are now log-scale means per group\n",
    "fitted_log = {\n",
    "    \"Neutral\":    model.params[\"const\"],\n",
    "    \"Republican\": model.params[\"const\"] + model.params[\"is_track_republican\"],\n",
    "    \"Democratic\": model.params[\"const\"] + model.params[\"is_track_democratic\"],\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: compute SE/CI on log_views, not raw view_count ───\n",
    "grp_stats = (\n",
    "    reg_df.groupby(\"group\")[\"log_views\"]\n",
    "    .agg(count=\"count\", std=\"std\")\n",
    "    .assign(se=lambda d: d[\"std\"] / np.sqrt(d[\"count\"]))\n",

    "grp_stats[\"ci_lo_log\"]  = grp_stats[\"fitted_log\"] - 1.96 * grp_stats[\"se\"]\n",
    "grp_stats[\"ci_hi_log\"]  = grp_stats[\"fitted_log\"] + 1.96 * grp_stats[\"se\"]\n",

    "# TRYING WITH LOG!\n",
    "\n",
    "# ── Scatterplot: observed points + OLS fitted means + 95% CI (log-space fit) ──\n",
    "# Each group jitter-plotted; fitted value = intercept (± coefficient), fit on log(views)\n",
    "rng = np.random.default_rng(42)\n",
    "COLORS = {\"Neutral\": \"gray\", \"Republican\": \"red\", \"Democratic\": \"blue\"}\n",
    "ORDER  = [\"Neutral\", \"Republican\", \"Democratic\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "def grp_label(row):\n",
    "    if row[\"is_track_republican\"] == 1: return \"Republican\"\n",
    "    if row[\"is_track_democratic\"]  == 1: return \"Democratic\"\n",
    "    return \"Neutral\"\n",
    "\n",
    "reg_df = top_with_politics[\n",
    "    [\"view_count\", \"is_track_republican\", \"is_track_democratic\"]\n",
    "].dropna().copy()\n",
    "reg_df[\"group\"] = reg_df.apply(grp_label, axis=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: drop non-positive views (log undefined at 0) and add log_views ───\n",
    "reg_df = reg_df[reg_df[\"view_count\"] > 0].copy()\n",
    "reg_df[\"log_views\"] = np.log(reg_df[\"view_count\"])\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: refit OLS on log_views instead of raw view_count ───\n",
    "model = sm.OLS(\n",
    "    reg_df[\"log_views\"],\n",
    "    sm.add_constant(reg_df[[\"is_track_republican\", \"is_track_democratic\"]]),\n",
    ").fit()\n",
    "\n",
    "# fitted values are now log-scale means per group\n",
    "fitted_log = {\n",
    "    \"Neutral\":    model.params[\"const\"],\n",
    "    \"Republican\": model.params[\"const\"] + model.params[\"is_track_republican\"],\n",
    "    \"Democratic\": model.params[\"const\"] + model.params[\"is_track_democratic\"],\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: compute SE/CI on log_views, not raw view_count ───\n",
    "grp_stats = (\n",
    "    reg_df.groupby(\"group\")[\"log_views\"]\n",
    "    .agg(count=\"count\", std=\"std\")\n",
    "    .assign(se=lambda d: d[\"std\"] / np.sqrt(d[\"count\"]))\n",
    ")\n",
    "grp_stats[\"fitted_log\"] = [fitted_log[g] for g in grp_stats.index]\n",
    "grp_stats[\"ci_lo_log\"]  = grp_stats[\"fitted_log\"] - 1.96 * grp_stats[\"se\"]\n",
    "grp_stats[\"ci_hi_log\"]  = grp_stats[\"fitted_log\"] + 1.96 * grp_stats[\"se\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: exponentiate fitted values and CI bounds back to raw-view scale\n",
    "#              so the plotted points/error bars are interpretable as view counts ───\n",
    "grp_stats[\"fitted\"] = np.exp(grp_stats[\"fitted_log\"])\n",
    "grp_stats[\"ci_lo\"]  = np.exp(grp_stats[\"ci_lo_log\"])\n",
    "grp_stats[\"ci_hi\"]  = np.exp(grp_stats[\"ci_hi_log\"])\n",

# ── Model 3: log(views) ~ is_neutral_content_democratic ──────────────────────
# Reference category (is_neutral_content_republican = 1, is_neutral_content_democratic = 0):
#   videos on a Republican-leaning neutral-content track
# k-1 dummies: drop is_neutral_content_republican (the reference)

rng = np.random.default_rng(42)

reg_df3 = top_with_politics[
    ["view_count", "is_neutral_content_republican", "is_neutral_content_democratic"]
].dropna().copy()
reg_df3 = reg_df3[reg_df3["view_count"] > 0].copy()
reg_df3["log_views"] = np.log(reg_df3["view_count"])

# Keep only rows that belong to exactly one of the two content groups
reg_df3 = reg_df3[
    (reg_df3["is_neutral_content_republican"] == 1) |
    (reg_df3["is_neutral_content_democratic"] == 1)
].copy()

# k-1 dummies: reference = is_neutral_content_republican
X3 = sm.add_constant(reg_df3[["is_neutral_content_democratic"]])
model3 = sm.OLS(reg_df3["log_views"], X3).fit()

# ── Group labels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def grp3(row):
    if row["is_neutral_content_democratic"] == 1: return "Neutral-content Democratic"
    return "Neutral-content Republican"

reg_df3["group"] = reg_df3.apply(grp3, axis=1)

ORDER3  = ["Neutral-content Republican", "Neutral-content Democratic"]
COLORS3 = {"Neutral-content Republican": "#c0392b", "Neutral-content Democratic": "#1a56c4"}

fitted_log3 = {
    "Neutral-content Republican": model3.params["const"],
    "Neutral-content Democratic": model3.params["const"] + model3.params["is_neutral_content_democratic"],
}

grp_stats3 = (
    reg_df3.groupby("group")["log_views"]
    .agg(count="count", std="std")
    .assign(se=lambda d: d["std"] / np.sqrt(d["count"]))
)
grp_stats3["fitted_log"] = [fitted_log3[g] for g in grp_stats3.index]
grp_stats3["ci_lo_log"]  = grp_stats3["fitted_log"] - 1.96 * grp_stats3["se"]
grp_stats3["ci_hi_log"]  = grp_stats3["fitted_log"] + 1.96 * grp_stats3["se"]
grp_stats3["fitted"] = np.exp(grp_stats3["fitted_log"])
grp_stats3["ci_lo"]  = np.exp(grp_stats3["ci_lo_log"])
grp_stats3["ci_hi"]  = np.exp(grp_stats3["ci_hi_log"])

x_pos3  = {g: i for i, g in enumerate(ORDER3)}
jitter  = 0.18

plt.style.use("seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid")
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5.6))

for group in ORDER3:
    sub = reg_df3[reg_df3["group"] == group]["view_count"].values
    xj  = rng.uniform(x_pos3[group] - jitter, x_pos3[group] + jitter, size=len(sub))
    ax.scatter(xj, sub, s=6, alpha=0.2, color=COLORS3[group], linewidths=0)

for group in ORDER3:
    xi = x_pos3[group]
    ax.errorbar(
        xi, grp_stats3.loc[group, "fitted"],
        yerr=[[grp_stats3.loc[group, "fitted"] - grp_stats3.loc[group, "ci_lo"]],
              [grp_stats3.loc[group, "ci_hi"]  - grp_stats3.loc[group, "fitted"]]],
        fmt="o", color=COLORS3[group], markersize=8, capsize=5, linewidth=1.5,
        label=group,
    )

ax.set_xticks(list(x_pos3.values()))
ax.set_xticklabels(
    [f"{g}\n(n = {grp_stats3.loc[g, 'count']:,})" for g in ORDER3],
    fontsize=9,
)
ax.set_yscale("log")
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(
    plt.FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f"{v/1_000:.0f}K" if v >= 1000 else f"{v:.0f}")
)
ax.set_ylabel("Video view count (log scale)")
ax.set_title(
    "OLS regression (log-views): video views by neutral-content political alignment\n"
    "(Reference: Neutral-content Republican)"
)
ax.legend(frameon=False)

p_dem3 = model3.pvalues["is_neutral_content_democratic"]
fig.text(
    0.01, -0.02,
    f"Note: Fit on log(view count); points/CI shown back-transformed to raw views. "
    f"Democratic coefficient p = {p_dem3:.3f}.",
    fontsize=8.5, color="gray",
)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

    "# ── Scatterplot: observed points + OLS fitted means + 95% CI ─────────────────\n",
    "# Each group jitter-plotted; fitted value = intercept (± coefficient)\n",
    "\n",
    "rng = np.random.default_rng(42)\n",

    "COLORS = {\"Neutral\": \"gray\", \"Republican\": \"red\", \"Democratic\": \"blue\"}\n",
    "ORDER  = [\"Neutral\", \"Republican\", \"Democratic\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "def grp_label(row):\n",
    "    if row[\"is_track_republican\"] == 1: return \"Republican\"\n",
    "    if row[\"is_track_democratic\"]  == 1: return \"Democratic\"\n",
    "    return \"Neutral\"\n",

    "reg_df = top_with_politics[\n",
    "    [\"view_count\", \"is_track_republican\", \"is_track_democratic\"]\n",

    "reg_df[\"group\"] = reg_df.apply(grp_label, axis=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "fitted = {\n",
    "    \"Neutral\":    model.params[\"const\"],\n",
    "    \"Republican\": model.params[\"const\"] + model.params[\"is_track_republican\"],\n",
    "    \"Democratic\": model.params[\"const\"] + model.params[\"is_track_democratic\"],\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "grp_stats = (\n",
    "    reg_df.groupby(\"group\")[\"view_count\"]\n",

    "\n",
    "# ── Scatterplot: observed points + OLS fitted means + 95% CI ─────────────────\n",
    "# Each group jitter-plotted; fitted value = intercept (± coefficient)\n",
    "\n",
    "rng = np.random.default_rng(42)\n",
    "\n",
    "COLORS = {\"Neutral\": \"gray\", \"Republican\": \"red\", \"Democratic\": \"blue\"}\n",
    "ORDER  = [\"Neutral\", \"Republican\", \"Democratic\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "def grp_label(row):\n",
    "    if row[\"is_track_republican\"] == 1: return \"Republican\"\n",
    "    if row[\"is_track_democratic\"]  == 1: return \"Democratic\"\n",
    "    return \"Neutral\"\n",
    "\n",
    "reg_df = top_with_politics[\n",
    "    [\"view_count\", \"is_track_republican\", \"is_track_democratic\"]\n",
    "].dropna().copy()\n",
    "reg_df[\"group\"] = reg_df.apply(grp_label, axis=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "fitted = {\n",
    "    \"Neutral\":    model.params[\"const\"],\n",
    "    \"Republican\": model.params[\"const\"] + model.params[\"is_track_republican\"],\n",
    "    \"Democratic\": model.params[\"const\"] + model.params[\"is_track_democratic\"],\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "grp_stats = (\n",
    "    reg_df.groupby(\"group\")[\"view_count\"]\n",

    "    .assign(se=lambda d: d[\"std\"] / np.sqrt(d[\"count\"]))\n",
    ")\n",
    "grp_stats[\"fitted\"] = [fitted[g] for g in grp_stats.index]\n",
    "grp_stats[\"ci_lo\"]  = grp_stats[\"fitted\"] - 1.96 * grp_stats[\"se\"]\n",

# ── Model 4: log(views) ~ is_neutral_content_democratic + is_track_democratic + is_track_republican ──
# Reference: is_neutral_content_republican  (k-1 dummies, 3 dummies included)
# Rows used: union of all four indicator groups

rng = np.random.default_rng(42)

reg_df4 = top_with_politics[
    ["view_count",
     "is_neutral_content_republican", "is_neutral_content_democratic",
     "is_track_democratic", "is_track_republican"]
].dropna().copy()
reg_df4 = reg_df4[reg_df4["view_count"] > 0].copy()
reg_df4["log_views"] = np.log(reg_df4["view_count"])

# Keep rows belonging to at least one of the four groups
reg_df4 = reg_df4[
    (reg_df4["is_neutral_content_republican"] == 1) |
    (reg_df4["is_neutral_content_democratic"]  == 1) |
    (reg_df4["is_track_democratic"]            == 1) |
    (reg_df4["is_track_republican"]            == 1)
].copy()

# k-1 dummies: reference = is_neutral_content_republican
X4 = sm.add_constant(
    reg_df4[["is_neutral_content_democratic", "is_track_democratic", "is_track_republican"]]
)
model4 = sm.OLS(reg_df4["log_views"], X4).fit()

# ── Group labels (priority order for overlapping dummies) ────────────────────
def grp4(row):
    if row["is_neutral_content_republican"] == 1: return "Neutral-content\nRepublican"
    if row["is_neutral_content_democratic"]  == 1: return "Neutral-content\nDemocratic"
    if row["is_track_republican"]            == 1: return "Track\nRepublican"
    if row["is_track_democratic"]            == 1: return "Track\nDemocratic"
    return "Other"

reg_df4["group"] = reg_df4.apply(grp4, axis=1)

ORDER4 = [
    "Neutral-content\nRepublican",
    "Neutral-content\nDemocratic",
    "Track\nRepublican",
    "Track\nDemocratic",
]
COLORS4 = {
    "Neutral-content\nRepublican": "#c0392b",
    "Neutral-content\nDemocratic": "#1a56c4",
    "Track\nRepublican":           "#e07070",
    "Track\nDemocratic":           "#6a8fd8",
}

fitted_log4 = {
    "Neutral-content\nRepublican": model4.params["const"],
    "Neutral-content\nDemocratic": model4.params["const"] + model4.params["is_neutral_content_democratic"],
    "Track\nRepublican":           model4.params["const"] + model4.params["is_track_republican"],
    "Track\nDemocratic":           model4.params["const"] + model4.params["is_track_democratic"],
}

reg_df4_plot = reg_df4[reg_df4["group"].isin(ORDER4)].copy()

grp_stats4 = (
    reg_df4_plot.groupby("group")["log_views"]
    .agg(count="count", std="std")
    .assign(se=lambda d: d["std"] / np.sqrt(d["count"]))
)
grp_stats4["fitted_log"] = [fitted_log4[g] for g in grp_stats4.index]
grp_stats4["ci_lo_log"]  = grp_stats4["fitted_log"] - 1.96 * grp_stats4["se"]
grp_stats4["ci_hi_log"]  = grp_stats4["fitted_log"] + 1.96 * grp_stats4["se"]
grp_stats4["fitted"] = np.exp(grp_stats4["fitted_log"])
grp_stats4["ci_lo"]  = np.exp(grp_stats4["ci_lo_log"])
grp_stats4["ci_hi"]  = np.exp(grp_stats4["ci_hi_log"])

x_pos4 = {g: i for i, g in enumerate(ORDER4)}
jitter = 0.18

plt.style.use("seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid")
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.6))

for group in ORDER4:
    sub = reg_df4_plot[reg_df4_plot["group"] == group]["view_count"].values
    xj  = rng.uniform(x_pos4[group] - jitter, x_pos4[group] + jitter, size=len(sub))
    ax.scatter(xj, sub, s=6, alpha=0.2, color=COLORS4[group], linewidths=0)

for group in ORDER4:
    xi = x_pos4[group]
    ax.errorbar(
        xi, grp_stats4.loc[group, "fitted"],
        yerr=[[grp_stats4.loc[group, "fitted"] - grp_stats4.loc[group, "ci_lo"]],
              [grp_stats4.loc[group, "ci_hi"]  - grp_stats4.loc[group, "fitted"]]],
        fmt="o", color=COLORS4[group], markersize=8, capsize=5, linewidth=1.5,
        label=group.replace("\n", " "),
    )

ax.set_xticks(list(x_pos4.values()))
ax.set_xticklabels(
    [f"{g}\n(n = {grp_stats4.loc[g, 'count']:,})" for g in ORDER4],
    fontsize=9,
)
ax.set_yscale("log")
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(
    plt.FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f"{v/1_000:.0f}K" if v >= 1000 else f"{v:.0f}")
)
ax.set_ylabel("Video view count (log scale)")
ax.set_title(
    "OLS regression (log-views): video views by neutral-content & track political alignment\n"
    "(Reference: Neutral-content Republican)"
)
ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=9)
fig.text(
    0.01, -0.02,
    "Note: Fit on log(view count); points/CI shown back-transformed to raw views. "
    "Reference group: is_neutral_content_republican.",
    fontsize=8.5, color="gray",
)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# Reference: is_neutral_content_republican  (k-1 dummies, 3 dummies included)
# Rows used: union of all four indicator groups

rng = np.random.default_rng(42)

reg_df4 = top_with_politics[
    ["view_count",
     "is_neutral_content_republican", "is_neutral_content_democratic",
     "is_track_democratic", "is_track_republican"]
].dropna().copy()
reg_df4 = reg_df4[reg_df4["view_count"] > 0].copy()
reg_df4["log_views"] = np.log(reg_df4["view_count"])

# Keep rows belonging to at least one of the four groups
reg_df4 = reg_df4[
    (reg_df4["is_neutral_content_republican"] == 1) |
    (reg_df4["is_neutral_content_democratic"]  == 1) |
    (reg_df4["is_track_democratic"]            == 1) |
    (reg_df4["is_track_republican"]            == 1)
].copy()

# k-1 dummies: reference = is_neutral_content_republican
X4 = sm.add_constant(
    reg_df4[["is_neutral_content_democratic", "is_track_democratic", "is_track_republican"]]
)
model4 = sm.OLS(reg_df4["log_views"], X4).fit()

# ── Group labels (priority order for overlapping dummies) ────────────────────
def grp4(row):
    if row["is_neutral_content_republican"] == 1: return "Neutral-content\nRepublican"
    if row["is_neutral_content_democratic"]  == 1: return "Neutral-content\nDemocratic"
    if row["is_track_republican"]            == 1: return "Track\nRepublican"
    if row["is_track_democratic"]            == 1: return "Track\nDemocratic"
    return "Other"

reg_df4["group"] = reg_df4.apply(grp4, axis=1)

ORDER4 = [
    "Neutral-content\nRepublican",
    "Neutral-content\nDemocratic",
    "Track\nRepublican",
    "Track\nDemocratic",
]
COLORS4 = {
    "Neutral-content\nRepublican": "#c0392b",
    "Neutral-content\nDemocratic": "#1a56c4",
    "Track\nRepublican":           "#e07070",
    "Track\nDemocratic":           "#6a8fd8",
}

fitted_log4 = {
    "Neutral-content\nRepublican": model4.params["const"],
    "Neutral-content\nDemocratic": model4.params["const"] + model4.params["is_neutral_content_democratic"],
    "Track\nRepublican":           model4.params["const"] + model4.params["is_track_republican"],
    "Track\nDemocratic":           model4.params["const"] + model4.params["is_track_democratic"],
}

reg_df4_plot = reg_df4[reg_df4["group"].isin(ORDER4)].copy()

grp_stats4 = (
    reg_df4_plot.groupby("group")["log_views"]
    .agg(count="count", std="std")
    .assign(se=lambda d: d["std"] / np.sqrt(d["count"]))
)
grp_stats4["fitted_log"] = [fitted_log4[g] for g in grp_stats4.index]
grp_stats4["ci_lo_log"]  = grp_stats4["fitted_log"] - 1.96 * grp_stats4["se"]
grp_stats4["ci_hi_log"]  = grp_stats4["fitted_log"] + 1.96 * grp_stats4["se"]
grp_stats4["fitted"] = np.exp(grp_stats4["fitted_log"])
grp_stats4["ci_lo"]  = np.exp(grp_stats4["ci_lo_log"])
grp_stats4["ci_hi"]  = np.exp(grp_stats4["ci_hi_log"])

    "\n",
    "# ── Scatterplot: observed points + OLS fitted means + 95% CI (log-space fit) ──\n",
    "# Each group jitter-plotted; fitted value = intercept (± coefficient), fit on log(views)\n",
    "rng = np.random.default_rng(42)\n",
    "COLORS = {\"Neutral\": \"gray\", \"Republican\": \"red\", \"Democratic\": \"blue\"}\n",
    "ORDER  = [\"Neutral\", \"Republican\", \"Democratic\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "def grp_label(row):\n",
    "    if row[\"is_track_republican\"] == 1: return \"Republican\"\n",
    "    if row[\"is_track_democratic\"]  == 1: return \"Democratic\"\n",
    "    return \"Neutral\"\n",
    "\n",
    "reg_df = top_with_politics[\n",
    "    [\"view_count\", \"is_track_republican\", \"is_track_democratic\"]\n",
    "].dropna().copy()\n",
    "reg_df[\"group\"] = reg_df.apply(grp_label, axis=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: drop non-positive views (log undefined at 0) and add log_views ───\n",
    "reg_df = reg_df[reg_df[\"view_count\"] > 0].copy()\n",
    "reg_df[\"log_views\"] = np.log(reg_df[\"view_count\"])\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: refit OLS on log_views instead of raw view_count ───\n",
    "model = sm.OLS(\n",
    "    reg_df[\"log_views\"],\n",
    "    sm.add_constant(reg_df[[\"is_track_republican\", \"is_track_democratic\"]]),\n",
    ").fit()\n",
    "\n",
    "# fitted values are now log-scale means per group\n",
    "fitted_log = {\n",
    "    \"Neutral\":    model.params[\"const\"],\n",
    "    \"Republican\": model.params[\"const\"] + model.params[\"is_track_republican\"],\n",
    "    \"Democratic\": model.params[\"const\"] + model.params[\"is_track_democratic\"],\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: compute SE/CI on log_views, not raw view_count ───\n",
    "grp_stats = (\n",
    "    reg_df.groupby(\"group\")[\"log_views\"]\n",
    "    .agg(count=\"count\", std=\"std\")\n",
    "    .assign(se=lambda d: d[\"std\"] / np.sqrt(d[\"count\"]))\n",
    ")\n",
    "grp_stats[\"fitted_log\"] = [fitted_log[g] for g in grp_stats.index]\n",
    "grp_stats[\"ci_lo_log\"]  = grp_stats[\"fitted_log\"] - 1.96 * grp_stats[\"se\"]\n",
    "grp_stats[\"ci_hi_log\"]  = grp_stats[\"fitted_log\"] + 1.96 * grp_stats[\"se\"]\n",
    "\n",

    "\n",
    "# ── Scatterplot: observed points + OLS fitted means + 95% CI ─────────────────\n",
    "# Each group jitter-plotted; fitted value = intercept (± coefficient)\n",
    "\n",
    "rng = np.random.default_rng(42)\n",
    "\n",
    "COLORS = {\"Neutral\": \"gray\", \"Republican\": \"red\", \"Democratic\": \"blue\"}\n",
    "ORDER  = [\"Neutral\", \"Republican\", \"Democratic\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "def grp_label(row):\n",
    "    if row[\"is_track_republican\"] == 1: return \"Republican\"\n",
    "    if row[\"is_track_democratic\"]  == 1: return \"Democratic\"\n",
    "    return \"Neutral\"\n",
    "\n",
    "reg_df = top_with_politics[\n",
    "    [\"view_count\", \"is_track_republican\", \"is_track_democratic\"]\n",
    "].dropna().copy()\n",
    "reg_df[\"group\"] = reg_df.apply(grp_label, axis=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "fitted = {\n",
    "    \"Neutral\":    model.params[\"const\"],\n",
    "    \"Republican\": model.params[\"const\"] + model.params[\"is_track_republican\"],\n",
    "    \"Democratic\": model.params[\"const\"] + model.params[\"is_track_democratic\"],\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "grp_stats = (\n",
    "    reg_df.groupby(\"group\")[\"view_count\"]\n",
    "    .agg(count=\"count\", std=\"std\")\n",
    "    .assign(se=lambda d: d[\"std\"] / np.sqrt(d[\"count\"]))\n",
    ")\n",
    "grp_stats[\"fitted\"] = [fitted[g] for g in grp_stats.index]\n",
    "grp_stats[\"ci_lo\"]  = grp_stats[\"fitted\"] - 1.96 * grp_stats[\"se\"]\n",
    "grp_stats[\"ci_hi\"]  = grp_stats[\"fitted\"] + 1.96 * grp_stats[\"se\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "cap = reg_df[\"view_count\"].quantile(0.99)\n",
    "reg_df_disp = reg_df[reg_df[\"view_count\"] <= cap].copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "x_pos  = {g: i for i, g in enumerate(ORDER)}\n",
    "jitter = 0.18\n",

    "plt.style.use(\"seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid\")\n",

# (Intercept omitted; reference = Neutral soundtrack)

_labels = {
    "is_track_republican": "Republican\nsoundtrack",

}
_keys   = list(_labels.keys())
_names  = [_labels[k] for k in _keys]
_coefs  = [model.params[k]  for k in _keys]
_lo     = [model.conf_int().loc[k, 0] for k in _keys]
_hi     = [model.conf_int().loc[k, 1] for k in _keys]

_y      = range(len(_keys))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 2.8))

ax.set_yticks(list(_y))

)
ax.tick_params(axis="x", labelsize=9.5, colors="#555", length=0)
ax.tick_params(axis="y", length=0)

for spine in ax.spines.values():
    spine.set_visible(False)
ax.spines["bottom"].set_visible(True)
ax.spines["bottom"].set_color("#c8c6be")
ax.spines["bottom"].set_linewidth(0.8)

ax.set_xlabel("Coefficient (views vs. Neutral soundtrack)", fontsize=10, color="#555", labelpad=6)
ax.set_title("Coefficient plot: OLS — view count ~ soundtrack alignment\n(ref: Neutral; 95% CI)", fontsize=11)
ax.yaxis.grid(False)
ax.xaxis.grid(True, color="#e8e6de", linewidth=0.7, zorder=0)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

    "\n",
    "# --- Line graph: share of engagement by political track category ---\n",
    "# Each metric column sums Democratic + Republican + Neutral = 100%\n",
    "\n",
    "# Raw sums from top_100_df.groupby(\"track_category\")\n",
    "sums = top_100_df.groupby(\"track_category\").agg(\n",
    "    videos=(\"music_id\", \"count\"),\n",
    "    views=(\"view_count\", \"sum\"),\n",
    "    likes=(\"like_count\", \"sum\"),\n",
    "    comments=(\"comment_count\", \"sum\"),\n",
    "    shares=(\"share_count\", \"sum\"),\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Convert each column to percentage of its total\n",
    "pct = sums.div(sums.sum(axis=0), axis=1) * 100\n",
    "\n",
    "metrics     = [\"Total videos\", \"Total views\", \"Total likes\", \"Total comments\", \"Total shares\"]\n",
    "col_keys    = [\"videos\", \"views\", \"likes\", \"comments\", \"shares\"]\n",
    "categories  = [\"Democratic\", \"Republican\", \"Neutral\"]\n",
    "colors      = {\"Democratic\": \"#1a56c4\", \"Republican\": \"#c0392b\", \"Neutral\": \"#898781\"}\n",
    "\n",
    "x = range(len(metrics))\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.2))\n",
    "fig.patch.set_facecolor(\"white\")\n",
    "ax.set_facecolor(\"white\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Gridlines\n",
    "ax.yaxis.grid(True, color=\"#e2e0d8\", linewidth=0.8, zorder=0)\n",
    "ax.set_axisbelow(True)\n",
    "\n",
    "for cat in categories:\n",
    "    y = [pct.loc[cat, k] for k in col_keys]\n",
    "    ax.plot(\n",
    "        x, y,\n",
    "        color=colors[cat],\n",
    "        linewidth=2,\n",
    "        marker=\"o\",\n",
    "        markersize=8,\n",
    "        markeredgewidth=2.5,\n",
    "        markeredgecolor=\"#f8f7f5\",   # surface ring\n",
    "        label=cat,\n",
    "        zorder=3,\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "# Axes formatting\n",
    "ax.set_xticks(list(x))\n",
    "ax.set_xticklabels(metrics, fontsize=10.5, color=\"#52514e\")\n",
    "ax.set_ylim(0, 100)\n",
    "ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f\"{v:.0f}%\"))\n",
    "ax.tick_params(axis=\"y\", labelsize=10, colors=\"#898781\", length=0)\n",
    "ax.tick_params(axis=\"x\", length=0, pad=8)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Spine cleanup\n",
    "for spine in ax.spines.values():\n",
    "    spine.set_visible(False)\n",
    "ax.spines[\"bottom\"].set_visible(True)\n",
    "ax.spines[\"bottom\"].set_color(\"#c8c6be\")\n",
    "ax.spines[\"bottom\"].set_linewidth(0.8)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Legend\n",
    "legend = ax.legend(\n",
    "    frameon=False,\n",
    "    fontsize=10,\n",
    "    loc=\"upper right\",\n",
    "    labelcolor=\"#52514e\",\n",
    "    handlelength=1.8,\n",
    "    handletextpad=0.6,\n",
    "    borderpad=0,\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Title\n",
    "ax.set_title(\n",
    "    \"Share of engagement by political alignment of top 2024 U.S. election TikTok audios\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]

    "\n",
    "# --- Grouped bar chart: Z-scores of mean engagement by political track category ---\n",
    "\n",
    "# Compute means per category\n",
    "means = top_100_df.groupby(\"track_category\").agg(\n",
    "    videos=(\"music_id\",     \"count\"),\n",
    "    views=(\"view_count\",    \"mean\"),\n",
    "    likes=(\"like_count\",    \"mean\"),\n",
    "    comments=(\"comment_count\", \"mean\"),\n",
    "    shares=(\"share_count\",  \"mean\"),\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Z-score each column across the 3 categories (mean=0, std=1 per metric)\n",
    "z = means.apply(stats.zscore, axis=0)\n",
    "\n",
    "metrics  = [\"Mean videos\", \"Mean views\", \"Mean likes\", \"Mean comments\", \"Mean shares\"]\n",
    "col_keys = [\"videos\", \"views\", \"likes\", \"comments\", \"shares\"]\n",
    "cats     = [\"Democratic\", \"Republican\", \"Neutral\"]\n",
    "colors   = {\"Democratic\": \"#1a56c4\", \"Republican\": \"#c0392b\", \"Neutral\": \"#898781\"}\n",
    "\n",
    "n_metrics = len(metrics)\n",
    "n_cats    = len(cats)\n",
    "bar_w     = 0.12\n",
    "group_gap = 0.72          # distance between group centres\n",
    "\n",
    "x_centres = [i * group_gap for i in range(n_metrics)]\n",
    "offsets   = [-bar_w, 0, bar_w]   # one offset per category\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.4))\n",
    "fig.patch.set_facecolor(\"white\")\n",
    "ax.set_facecolor(\"white\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Horizontal gridlines\n",
    "ax.yaxis.grid(True, color=\"#e2e0d8\", linewidth=0.8, zorder=0)\n",
    "ax.set_axisbelow(True)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Zero baseline\n",
    "ax.axhline(0, color=\"#c8c6be\", linewidth=0.9, zorder=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "for cat, offset in zip(cats, offsets):\n",
    "    bar_x = [c + offset for c in x_centres]\n",
    "    bar_h = [z.loc[cat, k] for k in col_keys]\n",
    "    ax.bar(\n",
    "        bar_x, bar_h,\n",
    "        width=bar_w - 0.02,       # 2 px surface gap between adjacent bars\n",
    "        color=colors[cat],\n",
    "        label=cat,\n",
    "        zorder=2,\n",
    "        clip_on=False,\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "# X-axis ticks centred on each group\n",
    "ax.set_xticks(x_centres)\n",
    "ax.set_xticklabels(metrics, fontsize=10.5, color=\"#52514e\")\n",
    "ax.tick_params(axis=\"x\", length=0, pad=8)\n",
    "ax.tick_params(axis=\"y\", labelsize=10, colors=\"#898781\", length=0)\n",
    "\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel(\"Z-score\", fontsize=10.5, color=\"#898781\", labelpad=8)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Spine cleanup\n",
    "for spine in ax.spines.values():\n",
    "    spine.set_visible(False)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Legend\n",
    "ax.legend(\n",
    "    frameon=False,\n",
    "    fontsize=10,\n",
    "    loc=\"lower right\",\n",
    "    labelcolor=\"#52514e\",\n",
    "    handlelength=1.2,\n",
    "    handletextpad=0.6,\n",
    "    borderpad=0,\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "ax.set_title(\n",
    "    \"Mean engagement Z-scores by by political alignment of top 2024 U.S. election TikTok audios\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]

    "\n",
    "# ── Linear regression: view_count ~ is_track_republican + is_track_democratic ──\n",
    "# Reference category (both dummies = 0): Neutral soundtrack\n",
    "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
    "from IPython.display import display\n",
    "\n",
    "# ── 1. Prepare data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n",
    "reg_df = top_with_politics[[\"view_count\", \"is_track_republican\", \"is_track_democratic\"]].dropna()\n",
    "\n",
    "X = sm.add_constant(reg_df[[\"is_track_republican\", \"is_track_democratic\"]])\n",
    "y = reg_df[\"view_count\"]\n",
    "model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()\n",
    "\n",
    "# ── 2. Build results table ───────────────────────────────────────────────────\n",
    "params = model.params\n",
    "bse    = model.bse\n",
    "tvals  = model.tvalues\n",
    "pvals  = model.pvalues\n",
    "ci     = model.conf_int()\n",
    "\n",
    "def fmt_p(p):\n",
    "    return \"< 0.001\" if p < 0.001 else f\"{p:.3f}\"\n",
    "\n",
    "def star(p):\n",
    "    if p < 0.001: return \"***\"\n",
    "    if p < 0.01:  return \"**\"\n",
    "    if p < 0.05:  return \"*\"\n",
    "    if p < 0.10:  return \"†\"\n",
    "    return \"\"\n",
    "\n",
    "labels = {\n",
    "    \"const\":               \"Intercept (Neutral soundtrack)\",\n",
    "    \"is_track_republican\": \"Republican soundtrack\",\n",
    "    \"is_track_democratic\": \"Democratic soundtrack\",\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "rows = []\n",
    "for key, label in labels.items():\n",
    "    rows.append({\n",
    "        \"Variable\":  label,\n",
    "        \"Coef.\":     f\"{params[key]:,.2f}\",\n",
    "        \"Std. Err.\": f\"{bse[key]:,.2f}\",\n",
    "        \"t\":         f\"{tvals[key]:.3f}\",\n",
    "        \"p\":         fmt_p(pvals[key]),\n",
    "        \"\":          star(pvals[key]),\n",
    "        \"95% CI\":    f\"[{ci.loc[key,0]:,.2f}, {ci.loc[key,1]:,.2f}]\",\n",
    "    })\n",
    "\n",
    "footer = {\n",
    "    \"Variable\":  f\"n = {int(model.nobs):,}   R² = {model.rsquared:.4f}   Adj. R² = {model.rsquared_adj:.4f}   \"\n",
    "                 f\"F({int(model.df_model)}, {int(model.df_resid)}) = {model.fvalue:.3f}   p {fmt_p(model.f_pvalue)}\",\n",
    "    \"Coef.\": \"\", \"Std. Err.\": \"\", \"t\": \"\", \"p\": \"\", \"\": \"\", \"95% CI\": \"\",\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "full_table = pd.DataFrame(rows + [footer])\n",
    "\n",
    "styled = (\n",
    "    full_table.style\n",
    "    .hide(axis=\"index\")\n",
    "    .set_caption(\"OLS: Video view count ~ soundtrack political alignment  (ref: Neutral)\")\n",

    "# TRYING WITH LOG!\n",
    "\n",
    "# ── Scatterplot: observed points + OLS fitted means + 95% CI (log-space fit) ──\n",
    "# Each group jitter-plotted; fitted value = intercept (± coefficient), fit on log(views)\n",
    "rng = np.random.default_rng(42)\n",
    "COLORS = {\"Neutral\": \"gray\", \"Republican\": \"red\", \"Democratic\": \"blue\"}\n",
    "ORDER  = [\"Neutral\", \"Republican\", \"Democratic\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "def grp_label(row):\n",
    "    if row[\"is_track_republican\"] == 1: return \"Republican\"\n",
    "    if row[\"is_track_democratic\"]  == 1: return \"Democratic\"\n",
    "    return \"Neutral\"\n",
    "\n",
    "reg_df = top_with_politics[\n",
    "    [\"view_count\", \"is_track_republican\", \"is_track_democratic\"]\n",
    "].dropna().copy()\n",
    "reg_df[\"group\"] = reg_df.apply(grp_label, axis=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: drop non-positive views (log undefined at 0) and add log_views ───\n",
    "reg_df = reg_df[reg_df[\"view_count\"] > 0].copy()\n",
    "reg_df[\"log_views\"] = np.log(reg_df[\"view_count\"])\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: refit OLS on log_views instead of raw view_count ───\n",
    "model = sm.OLS(\n",
    "    reg_df[\"log_views\"],\n",
    "    sm.add_constant(reg_df[[\"is_track_republican\", \"is_track_democratic\"]]),\n",
    ").fit()\n",
    "\n",
    "# fitted values are now log-scale means per group\n",
    "fitted_log = {\n",
    "    \"Neutral\":    model.params[\"const\"],\n",
    "    \"Republican\": model.params[\"const\"] + model.params[\"is_track_republican\"],\n",
    "    \"Democratic\": model.params[\"const\"] + model.params[\"is_track_democratic\"],\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: compute SE/CI on log_views, not raw view_count ───\n",
    "grp_stats = (\n",
    "    reg_df.groupby(\"group\")[\"log_views\"]\n",
    "    .agg(count=\"count\", std=\"std\")\n",
    "    .assign(se=lambda d: d[\"std\"] / np.sqrt(d[\"count\"]))\n",
    ")\n",
    "grp_stats[\"fitted_log\"] = [fitted_log[g] for g in grp_stats.index]\n",
    "grp_stats[\"ci_lo_log\"]  = grp_stats[\"fitted_log\"] - 1.96 * grp_stats[\"se\"]\n",
    "grp_stats[\"ci_hi_log\"]  = grp_stats[\"fitted_log\"] + 1.96 * grp_stats[\"se\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: exponentiate fitted values and CI bounds back to raw-view scale\n",
    "#              so the plotted points/error bars are interpretable as view counts ───\n",
    "grp_stats[\"fitted\"] = np.exp(grp_stats[\"fitted_log\"])\n",
    "grp_stats[\"ci_lo\"]  = np.exp(grp_stats[\"ci_lo_log\"])\n",
    "grp_stats[\"ci_hi\"]  = np.exp(grp_stats[\"ci_hi_log\"])\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: no need to cap at 99th percentile for display — log scale already\n",
    "#              compresses the tail, so we keep the full (positive) distribution ───\n",
    "reg_df_disp = reg_df.copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "x_pos  = {g: i for i, g in enumerate(ORDER)}\n",
    "jitter = 0.18\n",
    "plt.style.use(\"seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid\")\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5.6))\n",
    "\n",
    "for group in ORDER:\n",
    "    sub = reg_df_disp[reg_df_disp[\"group\"] == group][\"view_count\"].values\n",
    "    xj  = rng.uniform(x_pos[group] - jitter, x_pos[group] + jitter, size=len(sub))\n",
    "    ax.scatter(xj, sub, s=6, alpha=0.2, color=COLORS[group], linewidths=0)\n",
    "\n",
    "for group in ORDER:\n",
    "    xi  = x_pos[group]\n",
    "    ax.errorbar(\n",
    "        xi, grp_stats.loc[group, \"fitted\"],\n",
    "        yerr=[[grp_stats.loc[group, \"fitted\"] - grp_stats.loc[group, \"ci_lo\"]],\n",
    "              [grp_stats.loc[group, \"ci_hi\"]  - grp_stats.loc[group, \"fitted\"]]],\n",

    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "ax.set_xticks(list(x_pos.values()))\n",
    "ax.set_xticklabels(\n",
    "    [f\"{g}\\n(n = {grp_stats.loc[g, 'count']:,})\" for g in ORDER]\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: log-scale y-axis instead of linear with manual K-formatting ───\n",
    "ax.set_yscale(\"log\")\n",
    "ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(\n",
    "    plt.FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f\"{v/1_000:.0f}K\" if v >= 1000 else f\"{v:.0f}\")\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel(\"Video view count (log scale)\")\n",
    "ax.set_title(\n",
    "    \"OLS regression (log-views): video views by soundtrack political alignment\\n\"\n",
    "    \"(Reference: Neutral — both dummies = 0)\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "ax.legend(frameon=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: note reflects log-space fit; removed capping note, added p-value\n",

    "    fontsize=8.5, color=\"gray\",\n",
    ")\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()"

    "\n",
    "# ── Model 3: log(views) ~ is_neutral_content_democratic ──────────────────────\n",
    "# Reference category (is_neutral_content_republican = 1, is_neutral_content_democratic = 0):\n",
    "#   videos on a Republican-leaning neutral-content track\n",
    "# k-1 dummies: drop is_neutral_content_republican (the reference)\n",
    "\n",
    "rng = np.random.default_rng(42)\n",
    "\n",
    "reg_df3 = top_with_politics[\n",
    "    [\"view_count\", \"is_neutral_content_republican\", \"is_neutral_content_democratic\"]\n",
    "].dropna().copy()\n",
    "reg_df3 = reg_df3[reg_df3[\"view_count\"] > 0].copy()\n",
    "reg_df3[\"log_views\"] = np.log(reg_df3[\"view_count\"])\n",
    "\n",
    "# Keep only rows that belong to exactly one of the two content groups\n",
    "reg_df3 = reg_df3[\n",
    "    (reg_df3[\"is_neutral_content_republican\"] == 1) |\n",
    "    (reg_df3[\"is_neutral_content_democratic\"] == 1)\n",
    "].copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "# k-1 dummies: reference = is_neutral_content_republican\n",
    "X3 = sm.add_constant(reg_df3[[\"is_neutral_content_democratic\"]])\n",
    "model3 = sm.OLS(reg_df3[\"log_views\"], X3).fit()\n",
    "\n",
    "# ── Group labels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n",
    "def grp3(row):\n",
    "    if row[\"is_neutral_content_democratic\"] == 1: return \"Neutral-content Democratic\"\n",
    "    return \"Neutral-content Republican\"\n",
    "\n",
    "reg_df3[\"group\"] = reg_df3.apply(grp3, axis=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "ORDER3  = [\"Neutral-content Republican\", \"Neutral-content Democratic\"]\n",
    "COLORS3 = {\"Neutral-content Republican\": \"#c0392b\", \"Neutral-content Democratic\": \"#1a56c4\"}\n",
    "\n",
    "fitted_log3 = {\n",
    "    \"Neutral-content Republican\": model3.params[\"const\"],\n",
    "    \"Neutral-content Democratic\": model3.params[\"const\"] + model3.params[\"is_neutral_content_democratic\"],\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "grp_stats3 = (\n",
    "    reg_df3.groupby(\"group\")[\"log_views\"]\n",
    "    .agg(count=\"count\", std=\"std\")\n",
    "    .assign(se=lambda d: d[\"std\"] / np.sqrt(d[\"count\"]))\n",
    ")\n",
    "grp_stats3[\"fitted_log\"] = [fitted_log3[g] for g in grp_stats3.index]\n",
    "grp_stats3[\"ci_lo_log\"]  = grp_stats3[\"fitted_log\"] - 1.96 * grp_stats3[\"se\"]\n",
    "grp_stats3[\"ci_hi_log\"]  = grp_stats3[\"fitted_log\"] + 1.96 * grp_stats3[\"se\"]\n",
    "grp_stats3[\"fitted\"] = np.exp(grp_stats3[\"fitted_log\"])\n",
    "grp_stats3[\"ci_lo\"]  = np.exp(grp_stats3[\"ci_lo_log\"])\n",
    "grp_stats3[\"ci_hi\"]  = np.exp(grp_stats3[\"ci_hi_log\"])\n",
    "\n",
    "x_pos3  = {g: i for i, g in enumerate(ORDER3)}\n",
    "jitter  = 0.18\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.style.use(\"seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid\")\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5.6))\n",
    "\n",
    "for group in ORDER3:\n",
    "    sub = reg_df3[reg_df3[\"group\"] == group][\"view_count\"].values\n",
    "    xj  = rng.uniform(x_pos3[group] - jitter, x_pos3[group] + jitter, size=len(sub))\n",

    "for group in ORDER3:\n",
    "    xi = x_pos3[group]\n",
    "    ax.errorbar(\n",
    "        xi, grp_stats3.loc[group, \"fitted\"],\n",

    "              [grp_stats3.loc[group, \"ci_hi\"]  - grp_stats3.loc[group, \"fitted\"]]],\n",
    "        fmt=\"o\", color=COLORS3[group], markersize=8, capsize=5, linewidth=1.5,\n",
    "        label=group,\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "ax.set_xticks(list(x_pos3.values()))\n",
    "ax.set_xticklabels(\n",
    "    [f\"{g}\\n(n = {grp_stats3.loc[g, 'count']:,})\" for g in ORDER3],\n",
    "    fontsize=9,\n",
    ")\n",
    "ax.set_yscale(\"log\")\n",
    "ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(\n",
    "    plt.FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f\"{v/1_000:.0f}K\" if v >= 1000 else f\"{v:.0f}\")\n",
    ")\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel(\"Video view count (log scale)\")\n",
    "ax.set_title(\n",
    "    \"OLS regression (log-views): video views by neutral-content political alignment\\n\"\n",
    "    \"(Reference: Neutral-content Republican)\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "ax.legend(frameon=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "p_dem3 = model3.pvalues[\"is_neutral_content_democratic\"]\n",

    "    f\"Democratic coefficient p = {p_dem3:.3f}.\",\n",
    "    fontsize=8.5, color=\"gray\",\n",
    ")\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n"

    "# ── Linear regression: view_count ~ is_track_republican + is_track_democratic ──\n",

    "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
    "from IPython.display import display\n",
    "\n",
    "# ── 1. Prepare data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n",
    "reg_df = top_with_politics[[\"view_count\", \"is_track_republican\", \"is_track_democratic\"]].dropna()\n",
    "\n",
    "X = sm.add_constant(reg_df[[\"is_track_republican\", \"is_track_democratic\"]])\n",
    "y = reg_df[\"view_count\"]\n",
    "model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()\n",
    "\n",
    "# ── 2. Build results table ───────────────────────────────────────────────────\n",
    "params = model.params\n",
    "bse    = model.bse\n",
    "tvals  = model.tvalues\n",
    "pvals  = model.pvalues\n",
    "ci     = model.conf_int()\n",
    "\n",
    "def fmt_p(p):\n",
    "    return \"< 0.001\" if p < 0.001 else f\"{p:.3f}\"\n",
    "\n",
    "def star(p):\n",
    "    if p < 0.001: return \"***\"\n",
    "    if p < 0.01:  return \"**\"\n",
    "    if p < 0.05:  return \"*\"\n",
    "    if p < 0.10:  return \"†\"\n",

    "\n",
    "# ── Scatterplot: observed points + OLS fitted means + 95% CI ─────────────────\n",
    "# Each group jitter-plotted; fitted value = intercept (± coefficient)\n",
    "\n",
    "rng = np.random.default_rng(42)\n",

    "\n",
    "def grp_label(row):\n",
    "    if row[\"is_track_republican\"] == 1: return \"Republican\"\n",

    "\n",
    "reg_df = top_with_politics[\n",

    "].dropna().copy()\n",
    "reg_df[\"group\"] = reg_df.apply(grp_label, axis=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "fitted = {\n",

    "    \"Republican\": model.params[\"const\"] + model.params[\"is_track_republican\"],\n",

    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "grp_stats = (\n",

    "              [grp_stats.loc[group, \"ci_hi\"]  - grp_stats.loc[group, \"fitted\"]]],\n",

    "    )\n",

    "ax.set_xticks(list(x_pos.values()))\n",

    "    fontsize=8.5, color=\"gray\",\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n"

    "# TRYING WITH LOG!\n",
    "\n",
    "# ── Scatterplot: observed points + OLS fitted means + 95% CI (log-space fit) ──\n",
    "# Each group jitter-plotted; fitted value = intercept (± coefficient), fit on log(views)\n",
    "rng = np.random.default_rng(42)\n",
    "COLORS = {\"Neutral\": \"gray\", \"Republican\": \"red\", \"Democratic\": \"blue\"}\n",
    "ORDER  = [\"Neutral\", \"Republican\", \"Democratic\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "def grp_label(row):\n",
    "    if row[\"is_track_republican\"] == 1: return \"Republican\"\n",
    "    if row[\"is_track_democratic\"]  == 1: return \"Democratic\"\n",
    "    return \"Neutral\"\n",
    "\n",
    "reg_df = top_with_politics[\n",
    "    [\"view_count\", \"is_track_republican\", \"is_track_democratic\"]\n",
    "].dropna().copy()\n",
    "reg_df[\"group\"] = reg_df.apply(grp_label, axis=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: drop non-positive views (log undefined at 0) and add log_views ───\n",
    "reg_df = reg_df[reg_df[\"view_count\"] > 0].copy()\n",
    "reg_df[\"log_views\"] = np.log(reg_df[\"view_count\"])\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: refit OLS on log_views instead of raw view_count ───\n",
    "model = sm.OLS(\n",
    "    reg_df[\"log_views\"],\n",
    "    sm.add_constant(reg_df[[\"is_track_republican\", \"is_track_democratic\"]]),\n",
    ").fit()\n",
    "\n",
    "# fitted values are now log-scale means per group\n",
    "fitted_log = {\n",
    "    \"Neutral\":    model.params[\"const\"],\n",
    "    \"Republican\": model.params[\"const\"] + model.params[\"is_track_republican\"],\n",
    "    \"Democratic\": model.params[\"const\"] + model.params[\"is_track_democratic\"],\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: compute SE/CI on log_views, not raw view_count ───\n",
    "grp_stats = (\n",
    "    reg_df.groupby(\"group\")[\"log_views\"]\n",
    "    .agg(count=\"count\", std=\"std\")\n",
    "    .assign(se=lambda d: d[\"std\"] / np.sqrt(d[\"count\"]))\n",
    ")\n",
    "grp_stats[\"fitted_log\"] = [fitted_log[g] for g in grp_stats.index]\n",
    "grp_stats[\"ci_lo_log\"]  = grp_stats[\"fitted_log\"] - 1.96 * grp_stats[\"se\"]\n",
    "grp_stats[\"ci_hi_log\"]  = grp_stats[\"fitted_log\"] + 1.96 * grp_stats[\"se\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: exponentiate fitted values and CI bounds back to raw-view scale\n",
    "#              so the plotted points/error bars are interpretable as view counts ───\n",
    "grp_stats[\"fitted\"] = np.exp(grp_stats[\"fitted_log\"])\n",
    "grp_stats[\"ci_lo\"]  = np.exp(grp_stats[\"ci_lo_log\"])\n",
    "grp_stats[\"ci_hi\"]  = np.exp(grp_stats[\"ci_hi_log\"])\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: no need to cap at 99th percentile for display — log scale already\n",
    "#              compresses the tail, so we keep the full (positive) distribution ───\n",
    "reg_df_disp = reg_df.copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "x_pos  = {g: i for i, g in enumerate(ORDER)}\n",
    "jitter = 0.18\n",
    "plt.style.use(\"seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid\")\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5.6))\n",
    "\n",
    "for group in ORDER:\n",
    "    sub = reg_df_disp[reg_df_disp[\"group\"] == group][\"view_count\"].values\n",
    "    xj  = rng.uniform(x_pos[group] - jitter, x_pos[group] + jitter, size=len(sub))\n",
    "    ax.scatter(xj, sub, s=6, alpha=0.2, color=COLORS[group], linewidths=0)\n",
    "\n",
    "for group in ORDER:\n",
    "    xi  = x_pos[group]\n",
    "    ax.errorbar(\n",
    "        xi, grp_stats.loc[group, \"fitted\"],\n",
    "        yerr=[[grp_stats.loc[group, \"fitted\"] - grp_stats.loc[group, \"ci_lo\"]],\n",
    "              [grp_stats.loc[group, \"ci_hi\"]  - grp_stats.loc[group, \"fitted\"]]],\n",
    "        fmt=\"o\", color=COLORS[group], markersize=8, capsize=5, linewidth=1.5,\n",
    "        label=group,\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "ax.set_xticks(list(x_pos.values()))\n",
    "ax.set_xticklabels(\n",
    "    [f\"{g}\\n(n = {grp_stats.loc[g, 'count']:,})\" for g in ORDER]\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: log-scale y-axis instead of linear with manual K-formatting ───\n",
    "ax.set_yscale(\"log\")\n",
    "ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(\n",
    "    plt.FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f\"{v/1_000:.0f}K\" if v >= 1000 else f\"{v:.0f}\")\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel(\"Video view count (log scale)\")\n",
    "ax.set_title(\n",
    "    \"OLS regression (log-views): video views by soundtrack political alignment\\n\"\n",
    "    \"(Reference: Neutral — both dummies = 0)\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "ax.legend(frameon=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: note reflects log-space fit; removed capping note, added p-value\n",
    "#              pulled dynamically from the refit model instead of hardcoded ───\n",
    "p_dem = model.pvalues[\"is_track_democratic\"]\n",
    "fig.text(\n",
    "    0.01, -0.02,\n",
    "    f\"Note: Fit on log(view count); points/CI shown back-transformed to raw views. \"\n",
    "    f\"Democratic coefficient not significant (p = {p_dem:.3f}).\",\n",
    "    fontsize=8.5, color=\"gray\",\n",
    ")\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]

    "\n",
    "# ── Model 3: log(views) ~ is_neutral_content_democratic ──────────────────────\n",
    "# Reference category (is_neutral_content_republican = 1, is_neutral_content_democratic = 0):\n",
    "#   videos on a Republican-leaning neutral-content track\n",
    "# k-1 dummies: drop is_neutral_content_republican (the reference)\n",
    "\n",
    "rng = np.random.default_rng(42)\n",
    "\n",
    "reg_df3 = top_with_politics[\n",
    "    [\"view_count\", \"is_neutral_content_republican\", \"is_neutral_content_democratic\"]\n",
    "].dropna().copy()\n",
    "reg_df3 = reg_df3[reg_df3[\"view_count\"] > 0].copy()\n",
    "reg_df3[\"log_views\"] = np.log(reg_df3[\"view_count\"])\n",
    "\n",
    "# Keep only rows that belong to exactly one of the two content groups\n",
    "reg_df3 = reg_df3[\n",
    "    (reg_df3[\"is_neutral_content_republican\"] == 1) |\n",
    "    (reg_df3[\"is_neutral_content_democratic\"] == 1)\n",
    "].copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "# k-1 dummies: reference = is_neutral_content_republican\n",
    "X3 = sm.add_constant(reg_df3[[\"is_neutral_content_democratic\"]])\n",
    "model3 = sm.OLS(reg_df3[\"log_views\"], X3).fit()\n",
    "\n",
    "# ── Group labels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n",
    "def grp3(row):\n",
    "    if row[\"is_neutral_content_democratic\"] == 1: return \"Neutral-content Democratic\"\n",
    "    return \"Neutral-content Republican\"\n",
    "\n",
    "reg_df3[\"group\"] = reg_df3.apply(grp3, axis=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "ORDER3  = [\"Neutral-content Republican\", \"Neutral-content Democratic\"]\n",
    "COLORS3 = {\"Neutral-content Republican\": \"#c0392b\", \"Neutral-content Democratic\": \"#1a56c4\"}\n",
    "\n",
    "fitted_log3 = {\n",
    "    \"Neutral-content Republican\": model3.params[\"const\"],\n",
    "    \"Neutral-content Democratic\": model3.params[\"const\"] + model3.params[\"is_neutral_content_democratic\"],\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "grp_stats3 = (\n",
    "    reg_df3.groupby(\"group\")[\"log_views\"]\n",
    "    .agg(count=\"count\", std=\"std\")\n",
    "    .assign(se=lambda d: d[\"std\"] / np.sqrt(d[\"count\"]))\n",
    ")\n",
    "grp_stats3[\"fitted_log\"] = [fitted_log3[g] for g in grp_stats3.index]\n",
    "grp_stats3[\"ci_lo_log\"]  = grp_stats3[\"fitted_log\"] - 1.96 * grp_stats3[\"se\"]\n",
    "grp_stats3[\"ci_hi_log\"]  = grp_stats3[\"fitted_log\"] + 1.96 * grp_stats3[\"se\"]\n",
    "grp_stats3[\"fitted\"] = np.exp(grp_stats3[\"fitted_log\"])\n",
    "grp_stats3[\"ci_lo\"]  = np.exp(grp_stats3[\"ci_lo_log\"])\n",
    "grp_stats3[\"ci_hi\"]  = np.exp(grp_stats3[\"ci_hi_log\"])\n",
    "\n",
    "x_pos3  = {g: i for i, g in enumerate(ORDER3)}\n",
    "jitter  = 0.18\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.style.use(\"seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid\")\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5.6))\n",
    "\n",
    "for group in ORDER3:\n",
    "    sub = reg_df3[reg_df3[\"group\"] == group][\"view_count\"].values\n",
    "    xj  = rng.uniform(x_pos3[group] - jitter, x_pos3[group] + jitter, size=len(sub))\n",
    "    ax.scatter(xj, sub, s=6, alpha=0.2, color=COLORS3[group], linewidths=0)\n",
    "\n",
    "for group in ORDER3:\n",
    "    xi = x_pos3[group]\n",
    "    ax.errorbar(\n",
    "        xi, grp_stats3.loc[group, \"fitted\"],\n",
    "        yerr=[[grp_stats3.loc[group, \"fitted\"] - grp_stats3.loc[group, \"ci_lo\"]],\n",
    "              [grp_stats3.loc[group, \"ci_hi\"]  - grp_stats3.loc[group, \"fitted\"]]],\n",
    "        fmt=\"o\", color=COLORS3[group], markersize=8, capsize=5, linewidth=1.5,\n",
    "        label=group,\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "ax.set_xticks(list(x_pos3.values()))\n",
    "ax.set_xticklabels(\n",
    "    [f\"{g}\\n(n = {grp_stats3.loc[g, 'count']:,})\" for g in ORDER3],\n",
    "    fontsize=9,\n",
    ")\n",
    "ax.set_yscale(\"log\")\n",
    "ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(\n",
    "    plt.FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f\"{v/1_000:.0f}K\" if v >= 1000 else f\"{v:.0f}\")\n",
    ")\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel(\"Video view count (log scale)\")\n",
    "ax.set_title(\n",
    "    \"OLS regression (log-views): video views by neutral-content political alignment\\n\"\n",
    "    \"(Reference: Neutral-content Republican)\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "ax.legend(frameon=False)\n",
    "\n",
    "p_dem3 = model3.pvalues[\"is_neutral_content_democratic\"]\n",
    "fig.text(\n",
    "    0.01, -0.02,\n",
    "    f\"Note: Fit on log(view count); points/CI shown back-transformed to raw views. \"\n",
    "    f\"Democratic coefficient p = {p_dem3:.3f}.\",\n",
    "    fontsize=8.5, color=\"gray\",\n",
    ")\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]

    "reg_df4[\"log_views\"] = np.log(reg_df4[\"view_count\"])\n",
    "\n",
    "# Keep rows belonging to at least one of the four groups\n",
    "reg_df4 = reg_df4[\n",
    "    (reg_df4[\"is_neutral_content_republican\"] == 1) |\n",
    "    (reg_df4[\"is_neutral_content_democratic\"]  == 1) |\n",
    "    (reg_df4[\"is_track_democratic\"]            == 1) |\n",
    "    (reg_df4[\"is_track_republican\"]            == 1)\n",
    "].copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "# k-1 dummies: reference = is_neutral_content_republican\n",
    "X4 = sm.add_constant(\n",

    ")\n",
    "model4 = sm.OLS(reg_df4[\"log_views\"], X4).fit()\n",
    "\n",
    "# ── Group labels (priority order for overlapping dummies) ────────────────────\n",
    "def grp4(row):\n",
    "    if row[\"is_neutral_content_republican\"] == 1: return \"Neutral-content\\nRepublican\"\n",

    "# ── Linear regression: view_count ~ is_track_republican + is_track_democratic ──\n",

    "from IPython.display import display\n",

    "tvals  = model.tvalues\n",
    "pvals  = model.pvalues\n",

    "def fmt_p(p):\n",

    "\n",
    "def star(p):\n",
    "    if p < 0.001: return \"***\"\n",
    "    if p < 0.01:  return \"**\"\n",

    "labels = {\n",

    "\n",
    "rows = []\n",
    "for key, label in labels.items():\n",

    "def grp_label(row):\n",

    "    return \"Neutral\"\n",
    "\n",
    "reg_df = top_with_politics[\n",
    "    [\"view_count\", \"is_track_republican\", \"is_track_democratic\"]\n",
    "].dropna().copy()\n",
    "reg_df[\"group\"] = reg_df.apply(grp_label, axis=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "fitted = {\n",
    "    \"Neutral\":    model.params[\"const\"],\n",
    "    \"Republican\": model.params[\"const\"] + model.params[\"is_track_republican\"],\n",
    "    \"Democratic\": model.params[\"const\"] + model.params[\"is_track_democratic\"],\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "grp_stats = (\n",
    "    reg_df.groupby(\"group\")[\"view_count\"]\n",

    "\n",
    "# ── Scatterplot: observed points + OLS fitted means + 95% CI (log-space fit) ──\n",

    "rng = np.random.default_rng(42)\n",

    "].dropna().copy()\n",
    "reg_df[\"group\"] = reg_df.apply(grp_label, axis=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: drop non-positive views (log undefined at 0) and add log_views ───\n",
    "reg_df = reg_df[reg_df[\"view_count\"] > 0].copy()\n",
    "reg_df[\"log_views\"] = np.log(reg_df[\"view_count\"])\n",

    "# ─── CHANGED: refit OLS on log_views instead of raw view_count ───\n",
    "model = sm.OLS(\n",

    ").fit()\n",
    "\n",
    "# fitted values are now log-scale means per group\n",
    "fitted_log = {\n",
    "    \"Neutral\":    model.params[\"const\"],\n",
    "    \"Republican\": model.params[\"const\"] + model.params[\"is_track_republican\"],\n",
    "    \"Democratic\": model.params[\"const\"] + model.params[\"is_track_democratic\"],\n",
    "}\n",
    "\n",
    "# ─── CHANGED: compute SE/CI on log_views, not raw view_count ───\n",
    "grp_stats = (\n",
    "    reg_df.groupby(\"group\")[\"log_views\"]\n",
    "    .agg(count=\"count\", std=\"std\")\n",
    "    .assign(se=lambda d: d[\"std\"] / np.sqrt(d[\"count\"]))\n",

    "grp_stats[\"fitted_log\"] = [fitted_log[g] for g in grp_stats.index]\n",
